responsibility: Defines the PA-RISC backend’s machine constraints used by reload, instruction recognition, and inline asm matching. It assigns register classes such as general, floating-point, shift, and upper-FP registers to constraint letters, and defines immediate and memory constraints tied to PA-specific encodings like 11/14-bit immediates, ldil/zdepi/depi masks, lo_sum DLT addresses, indexed loads, and legal integer or FP store/load memory forms, thereby supplying the operand vocabulary consumed by pa.md patterns and user asm.
